title: Levels 974, 3999 and 188
note: Shots carry a 974-, 3999- or 188- prefix: review/b16/sbs holds copies of review/baseline/974, /3999 and /188 (reshot in B16 on a build of unchanged main; the B0 sets are kept as 974-b0, 3999-b0 and 188-b0) and of the final after shots. B16 added the kitchen, bath, Kitty's room, bed, hall and master bedroom in Level 974; a marble close-up, a food court table, an arcade cabinet, a shopfront fascia and the vending machines in Level 3999; a moss tuft, a bollard, the paving, two ground-floor windows and the downpipe's foot in Level 188. 3999 is lit by its neon in the dark and 188 is night by design.
